edition.name: Original
edition.versionTitle: The Sayings of the Jewish Fathers, Gorfinkle, second edition (1916)
edition.attribution: Pirke Avot: The Sayings of the Jewish Fathers, translated with notes by Joseph I. Gorfinkle, second edition, New York, 1916; digital transcription produced by Dan Dyckman, ebook 8547.
edition.changes: Extracted six chapter sections including source notes; normalized whitespace. The digital transcription omits the Hebrew and preserves its own source numbering. No OCR or new translation. Two chapter 2 transcription errors were corrected from the 1916 print; see printCorrectionEvidence. Four additional chapter 5 transcription errors were corrected against the 1916 print; see source-manifest.json.
edition.coverageStatus: Six English chapters with Gorfinkle notes. Source numbering and note placement are preserved; paragraph-level alignment with Amudi’s Hebrew has not been established.

publicationEvidence: Second edition title page dates the edition 1916 and copyright 1913. University of Pennsylvania catalog dates the translation 1913. A pre-1931 US publication is public domain in the US; reuse status elsewhere depends on local law.
scope: Six English chapters with Gorfinkle notes. Source numbering and note placement are preserved; paragraph-level alignment with Amudi’s Hebrew has not been established.
limitations: The Gutenberg transcription says its Hebrew was omitted, that footnotes were moved after their paragraphs, and that some transliterations or bracketed transcription notes were added. This is not a full independent proofreading or a worldwide rights certification.

corrections.before: Do His will as if it were thy will. Nullify thy will before His will
corrections.after: Do His will as if it were thy will, that He may do thy will as if it were His will. Nullify thy will before His will

corrections.after: The more flesh, the more worms;

printCorrectionEvidence.method: Visually read the printed pages, compared with the existing typed source, and corrected only the verified differences; no OCR or new translation.

chapter5PrintCorrectionEvidence.method: Visually compared printed pages 80–81 with the existing typed source; no OCR or new translation.
